name: Sandbox-bootstrap-pack loop failed — chain pause marker
description:
ADR-042 §addendum sandbox-bootstrap pack failure handler. Fires when any pack role terminates with outcome=failed BEFORE emitting its decide() terminal — model timeout, NATS blip, OOM, panic, docker daemon disconnect during execute, max_iterations hit without terminal decide. Without this rule, the failure stalls the chain silently. Stamps chain.paused.marker for operator surfacing.

Mirrors research/08 and autoresearch/11 exactly, scoped to sandbox-bootstrap role tokens.

metadata.registry_state_after_pause_caveat: When a bootstrap arc fails partway through provisioning, the registry may be left in state=provisioning. The plan persona's iteration 3 in rule 01 handles this on the NEXT bootstrap arc: a query_sandbox_tenant returning state=provisioning routes through needs_clarification with a 'currently being provisioned' message. To recover from a wedged provisioning state, operator must manually clear the registry entry (or use a future `task sandbox:gc` recipe). v1 ships operator-driven recovery; auto-recovery is a §F follow-up.
metadata.mirrors_research_and_autoresearch_patter: Same shape as research/08 and autoresearch/11. Marker-only triple; full §D5 audit triples were retired in MVP-7.
